d: What exactly makes Vaibhav Sooryavanshi so special? The 15-year-old has already broken records in the IPL, List A cricket and T20 cricket, but his stunning 204 against UAE has taken the conversation to another level. His ability to hit sixes at will, dominate experienced bowlers and produce extraordinary scores at such a young age has made him one of the most exciting young talents in world cricket. Comparisons with some of India's greatest batting prodigies are inevitable, but Sooryavanshi is only beginning his journey. Rupha Ramani dives deep into what makes this young Indian batting…
